fusions.name: Crushing Embrace
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and crush it in a weapon strike for 12 damage. It is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and moves 35% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pinned Beneath
fusions.desc: Mauls everything in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaving each enemy caught [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Winter Den Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 30% and your physical resistance by 10% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Goaded Temper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
